items.title: Al Wynn Interview, 1958-05-29
items.q: I figure like on business association with Freddie, because he did work in my lawn grounds for me, see. I owned a pleasure ground and dance and lawn parties and things, and I give their band more credit of bringing people into place, see, other than that.

ctx.x: I thought you were in Clarence Jones.
One time Clarence Williams did have a publishing house here at your music store.
